Wrong password / wrong email / both: 401 with the same generic message, no cookie
Email is case-insensitive and trimmed; the password is exact (no trim, case-sensitive)
Very long inputs and SQL / HTML injection strings are refused cleanly (401, JSON, nothing reflected)
Brute force: 5 failures from one address, then the 6th try — even with the right password — is 429; another address is not affected
Session token: forged-clock expiry, far-future expiry, tampered payload, wrong key, garbage and oversized cookies are all refused (pages redirect, API 401)
Session cookie flags: HttpOnly, SameSite=Lax, Secure (production build), Path=/, Max-Age 12 h
Sign out clears the cookie AND the signed-out session can no longer be replayed
Changing ADMIN_PASSWORD signs everyone out (a cookie from the old password is refused by a server with a new one)
Admin switched off (no env): every admin page (15) says "not set up" and every admin API (10 routes) answers 404

Without a cookie every admin API route (POST /api/admin/erase, GET /api/admin/events.csv, GET /api/admin/games/DWAAA, GET /api/admin/games, GET /api/admin/games.csv, POST /api/admin/login, POST /api/admin/logout, GET /api/admin/notify.csv, GET /api/admin/players.csv, POST /api/admin/refresh) answers 401 — except sign-in

Without a cookie every admin page (15: /admin/acquisition /admin/engagement /admin/events /admin/funnels /admin/games/DWAAA /admin/games /admin/geography /admin/notify /admin /admin/players/aaaa0001 /admin/players /admin/privacy /admin/retention /admin/technology /admin/login) redirects (307) to /admin/login and sends no content
CSRF: every state-changing admin API refuses a missing Origin, a foreign Origin, Origin "null" and a non-JSON body — even with a valid session
Never cached, never indexed: admin pages and APIs send no-store + X-Robots-Tag noindex; pages carry a robots meta; robots.txt disallows /admin; the sitemap has no admin URL
Sign-in page: signed-in visit goes to /admin; wrong methods are refused; failure answers take ≥ 400 ms whatever was wrong
Security headers on admin responses: X-Frame-Options SAMEORIGIN, frame-ancestors self, nosniff
A valid batch is answered 204 (no body, no-store) and stored: name, properties, game code, masked path, session, short device id
Limits: a body over 16 KB is 413 (with and without Content-Length); nothing is stored
More than 50 events in one batch: the first 50 are stored, the rest dropped
Whitelist: unknown event names, extra properties, wrong types, bad enum values and over-long strings are dropped; nothing free-form is stored
Device token: header wins; body "tk" works (sendBeacon); a missing or malformed token stores the events with no device
Bad requests: malformed JSON, a non-object, a missing / bad session id, events not a list → 400; GET, PUT, DELETE → 405
Crawlers and link-preview fetchers are answered 204 and not stored (Googlebot, WhatsApp preview, facebookexternalhit, headless Chrome, curl)
IP and place come from headers only: body values ignored; first X-Forwarded-For hop; IPv6; IPv4-mapped; garbage → x-real-ip → none; URL-encoded city decoded; markup stripped
Rate limit: the 121st batch from one device within a minute is 429 and not stored; another device on another address is unaffected
Events sent from /admin paths are dropped by the server
Event time: "o" (age) is honoured up to 1 hour; negative, absurd and non-numeric ages cannot post-date or back-date an event
Order and duplicates: events of a batch keep their order; the server has no de-duplication (a batch sent twice is stored twice) — documented
Game facts are not double counted with events: one real game + five fake "host_created" / "game_start" / "join_ok" events still count as one game with one player
Public responses (create, view as host / player / visitor, every action, notify) carry no IP, place, user-agent, token or token hash, and no other player's ticket or dabs

cases.title: Admin pages, JSON and CSV exports never contain a ticket, dabs, a device token or a full token hash (only the 8-character id)

CSV exports: every row has the header's column count; no cell starts with = + - @ tab or CR (formula injection) in the plays, players, events and notify exports; values with commas, quotes, emoji and Unicode survive a round trip
Chart "CSV" buttons (made in the browser) are defused the same way
Custom ranges: one day; inverted from/to is swapped; a future range is pulled back to today; more than 90 days is capped at the oldest kept day; rubbish falls back to 7 days
The date range and compare switch follow the operator through every sidebar link, survive Back / Forward, and a deep link opens the same view
Plays search: code, part of a name, any letter case, Unicode, emoji, quotes, %, _, <script>, SQL text — each returns exactly the rows a plain substring match gives, and the page never errors
Plays sort (created / players / activity × both directions) is truly ordered over ALL pages; pages do not overlap or skip; page past the end, page 0, -1 and "abc" behave
Plays column picker hides / shows columns and remembers the choice after a reload; quick filters and the status filter give the right totals on the page

Play detail for a lobby, a live, a finished, an expired and a two-round game shows the right status, facts, people (with IP / place / device) and earlier rounds; unknown and malformed codes give a clear "not found"
Player detail: a device with two names lists both; a host who never played shows hosted 1 / joined 0; every IP seen is listed; unknown, short and malformed ids give a clear "not found"
Events explorer: 50 per page, pages do not overlap, last page is partial, filters combine, invalid filters are ignored (not an error)
When an aggregate query throws, every admin page still answers with a helpful message inside the admin frame (not a blank or crash page), and the API answers a JSON 500

Keyboard only: Tab reaches the sidebar, range buttons, Refresh, Sign out and the page's controls in a sensible order; every focused control shows a visible focus ring; chart Table switch works with Enter

Charts are accessible: each chart has a text alternative or table twin with the same numbers, the Chart/Table switch exposes aria-pressed, tables have column headers; one <h1> per page; the page has a <main> and labelled navigation
Print: the page renders to PDF without the sidebar / top bar / buttons, and every chart's numbers are printed as a table
Admin pages send no analytics: visiting all of them makes no request to /api/t, and they load nothing from another site
Signed-in visit to /admin/login lands on /admin; sign-out button returns to the sign-in page and Back does not show admin data again
Server time of every admin page with 328 games / 6641 events (memory mode): none over 1.5 s

The raw device token sent in the beacon body ("tk") is hashed at once: it is never echoed, never in any admin page / export / JSON, and never in the server log — only the 8-character id derived from its hash appears

Names typed on the player side — , "=…", "+…", "-…", "@…" — created through the real public API: inert on the plays list, play detail, players list, player detail and events pages, and defused in the plays and players exports

A real browser visit: session_start + page views are batched (not one request per event); closing the tab sends session_end through sendBeacon; with /api/t blocked (ad blocker) hosting and joining a game still work with no page error

Deployed before migration 0003 (a stand-in database that only has 0001 + 0002): creating a game and POST /api/t still work; every admin page answers 200 with the "Run migration 0003" notice and no crash; erase answers a clear 409; nothing is retried in a loop
Erase cannot be triggered cross-site or without a session: foreign Origin 403, form post 415, no cookie 401 — and the device is still there afterwards
Bad ids are refused with 400 and nothing changes: empty, 7 and 9 characters, non-hex, a full hash, SQL / wildcard text, a number, an array
Erasing a device that does not exist answers found:false with zero counts and removes nothing

Erase "bbbb0002" (Meera: 4 games, 2 names): the answer's counts equal the raw rows; device row, IPs, events and per-game place/device are gone; names become "Erased player" everywhere incl. earlier rounds; expired games lose the device link, the still-open game keeps the seat
Idempotent: erasing the same id again removes nothing more (only the seat in the still-open game is reported), and other people's data is untouched
Two devices whose 8-character ids collide ("12345678"): erase removes BOTH (documented limitation of the short id)
Audit: every erase (also "not found" ones) leaves one line with the id and counts — and no name, IP or place
Sign-in block lifts after 15 minutes (shifted clock)
A session expires at exactly 12 h (shifted clock)
Retention, memory store: tickets and dabs erased at 24 h; game summary, devices, IPs, events, participations deleted at 90 days, not a minute earlier
A device seen again keeps its row; its old events and old IP still expire
Retention, PostgreSQL: purge at 24 h / 90 days for games and for the five analytics tables; retention argument
